info.name: Vtiger CRM - Notifications API
info.description: Postman collection for Firebase push notifications

variable.description: JWT authentication token (required for FCM token registration)
User ID to send notification to

request.description: Login to get JWT token. Required for FCM token registration.

Register or update FCM token for push notifications. This must be called from the mobile app after user login.

**Required Fields:**
- `fcm_token`: Firebase Cloud Messaging token from the device
- `device_type`: Optional - 'android', 'ios', or 'web'
- `device_id`: Optional - Unique device identifier

body.raw:
{
  "user_id": {{user_id}},
  "title": "New Ticket Assignment",
  "message": "Hi ConnecTEL Private Limited, You have been assigned a new ticket #{{ticket_number}} for Mohsin Nasim (Residential).",
  "ticket_id": {{ticket_id}},
  "ticket_number": "{{ticket_number}}",
  "type": "ticket_assigned"
}

request.description:
Send Firebase push notification when a ticket is assigned to a user.

**Note:** This endpoint does NOT require authentication as it's called internally by the CRM system.

**Required Fields:**
- `user_id`: ID of the user to notify
- `title`: Notification title
- `message`: Notification message
- `ticket_id`: Ticket ID
- `ticket_number`: Ticket number (e.g., TT63152)
- `type`: Must be 'ticket_assigned' or 'ticket_updated'
